questions: When a bill doesn't split evenly, who should get the extra pesewa: the same person each time, someone chosen at random, or should we take turns?
Besides each person's balance, do you also want to see exactly who owes whom and how much, for example a short list of payments that would settle everyone up?
Should you be able to add or remove members after a group has started, or edit and delete an expense or a payment once it is recorded?
answers: Any of them, as long as the shares differ by at most one pesewa and add up to the bill.
